about: The collecta of the formulary “Saint Joseph, Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the merits of Your most holy Mother’s spouse help us, we beseech You, O Lord, that through his intercession we may receive what we cannot obtain by our own efforts. You live and reign with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
